edinburgh_scott_guide.text: Welcome to the Scott Monument. Sir Walter Scott sits under the arches with his deerhound Maida, carved from a single block of Carrara marble.
George Meikle Kemp, a self-taught joiner, won the contest to design it. Sadly he died in 1844 and never saw it finished. It opened in 1846.
There are 287 steps to the top, and 64 little statues of Scott's characters round the tower. Bring good knees.

edinburgh_scott_reader.text: I counted the steps twice and got two different answers. Scott would call that a plot twist.
